description: Use when you need historical exchange rates, a historical FX rate series, forex history or a currency trend. Do not use for rates older than 90 days, live quotes or crypto (one ECB rate per business day). Returns JSON with historical exchange rates: 90 days of daily ECB euro reference rates (free at ecb.europa.eu) for up to 10 currencies, rebased to any base as cross rates, with min, max and percent change for 0.005 USDC per call. Typical response time 1500 ms (p95). Category: Data.

base.description: Base currency, ISO 4217 (EUR when omitted), e.g. USD

days.description: Calendar days back from endDate, 1 to 90 (90 when omitted; ignored with startDate), e.g. 30

endDate.description: Last day, YYYY-MM-DD (latest ECB day when omitted), e.g. 2026-09-30

response_format.description: concise (the default when omitted) keeps the JSON short: long fields such as base64 images or audio come back as separate image/audio content blocks and other long strings are cut with a marker; detailed returns the full JSON

startDate.description: First day, YYYY-MM-DD, within the last 90 days, e.g. 2026-09-01

symbols.description: Currencies to return, ISO 4217, up to 10, e.g. ["USD", "BRL"]

name: blackwood_fx_history

next.description: Suggested next paid call in the same family (call it in a loop when the task continues)

sample.description: Free fixed sample of the whole family

service.description: Service id of the suggested next paid call

tool.description: MCP tool name of the same call

url.description: Paid route of the next call

useWhen.description: When the next call is the right one

anyOf.description: x402 PaymentRequired (returned with isError when payment is needed)

title: Historical exchange rates
